picks.excerpt: Honor's Robot Phone ships with a motorised pop-up camera gimbal that rotates 360 degrees and a 'YOYO Robot Mode' that gesture-controls and tracks subjects on its own. It is a rare attempt to give an AI assistant an actual moving body inside a phone.
picks.rationale: The first shipping phone that gives an AI assistant a moving body — a genuinely new industrial-design and interaction problem, not a spec bump.

picks.excerpt: The Tensor G6's TPU brings 50% more compute and runs local workloads up to 3.5x faster at 3.5x lower energy, letting Gemini Nano handle transcription, sign-to-text and live translation entirely on device. On-device inference, not raw CPU, is where the Pixel 11 actually moved.
picks.rationale: Resets what designers can assume about on-device AI budgets — transcription and live translation now run locally with no round trip; chosen as the single best angle on the Pixel 11 launch.

picks.excerpt: Matic's new 'Matic Cues' firmware adds a 'Hey Matic' wake phrase and gesture control, with Google Gemini parsing compound commands like 'vacuum the dining room rug and then mop the bedroom.' It is a voice-first rewrite of how you operate a home robot.
picks.rationale: A shipping home robot drops the app-first control model for compound voice commands and gestures — a concrete case of an LLM replacing a UI, not decorating one.

picks.excerpt: Meta is handing 15,000 Ray-Ban Meta glasses to charity Vision Ireland, positioning the camera-and-voice wearable as an accessibility device that reads text aloud and describes objects. It is the clearest test yet of whether AI glasses earn their keep as an assistive interface rather than a novelty.
picks.rationale: The largest real-world deployment yet of AI glasses as an assistive interface — accessibility, not novelty, becomes the test case for camera-and-voice wearables.

picks.excerpt: The Pixel Watch 5 arrives just as the redesigned Google Health app's AI coach is hallucinating workouts and stats, and long-time Fitbit users are revolting. A sharp case study in what happens when a generative layer is bolted onto a trusted health interface.
picks.rationale: The counterweight pick: a shipped generative layer on a trusted data interface fails publicly, showing exactly where AI should not be allowed to speak for the numbers.
